fontProvenance: Installed macOS and Microsoft fonts. Native PDF embeds subsets of ArialMT, Arial-BoldItalicMT, TimesNewRomanPS-ItalicMT and AppleColorEmoji. This recorded font environment is qualified.
reproduction: Generate IWorkPagesWritingTests.Example(), independently decode with Build/IWork/verify-pages-creation.py using the pinned descriptor, then open a working copy in Pages 15.4. Change reset to edited, save, close and reopen. Export best-quality PDF and Word with password/comment options off. Inspect both PDF pages and compare complete DOCX body text and page settings.
boundaries: The native Pages graph, edit/reopen and PDF retain the requested character formatting. Apple DOCX export assigns Arial Unicode MS to selected runs and writes false bold/italic overrides over styled character properties; its typography is not qualified as equivalent.

OfficeIMO strict saved/reopened DOCX retains the source text, paragraph/run order, sizes, colors and explicit character decorations. A final empty source paragraph comes from the terminating LF; Apple exports only the 83 authored paragraphs.

The writer does not measure pagination or embed fonts. Other producer versions, font environments, scripts, lists, tables, images, custom headers/footers, section layouts and loaded-source save-back remain outside this profile.
